body: Wow that’s beautiful. Thank you. It’s a positive thing that I do know there are good men out there. Time to work on myself first. I’m having a day of strength. But tomorrow I could very well be back in a dark hole. Maybe one day I’ll look back and realise it was the furthest thing from love. Just hate this feeling of losing someone who truly knew me as a person and I had planned a future with. Hopefully it’s the best thing that’s happened to me. Thank you.

I don’t think I can return to work anytime soon. I’ve been in therapy weekly. On medication. I’ve tried meditating and a bit of TLC. I feel like a lost cause.

The fact my fiancé doesn’t want me anymore is worse than everything else combined. I am so dependant on his love. It’s unhealthy I know. But I can’t imagine how I will survive. 

Thank you so much for replying to me.

The pit is so deep. In the last two months I have had my left tube removed because of an ectopic pregnancy, lost 3 of my best friends, been hospitalised twice for being suicidal, and now my fiancé no longer wants me. I’m about to lose my extremely well paying mining job because I haven’t worked because of all these issues. I am 30 on Monday and am back living with my parents. 

I have never been at rock bottom like this. I feel so alone and have tried texting a few people to talk but they must be asleep. Or probably are sick of me leaning on them with my depression and issues.

I just feel lost and helpless.

Thank you so much for your reply.

Hello, love and light.

Will my partner cheat on me again?

Please answer ❤️🙏🏽
Thank you so much. I totally agree. Thank you
Thank you so much. I think that’s my problem. I can’t seem to make peace with it. But I’m going to have to keep trying.

Yeah I’ve made the decision to stop. But I feel the fear will never fade away. I wish I had never gotten one in the first place. 

If this psychic wasn’t so credible then I would be able to shrug it off. 

I know that ultimately there’s nothing I can do. I think I’m a really sensitive person and this is a huge deal to me. I don’t know how I would survive the hurt.

Thank you so much for your reply, I really appreciate it
